name: job_description_builder
description: AI-powered job description creator for recruiters. Generates, enhances, or clones job descriptions using content from the ATS (source of truth), a saved JD library, or fresh AI generation. Includes inclusivity and bias scanning, fill rate and quality-of-hire intelligence, multi-language support, and export to HTML (external / internal modes). Saves finalized JDs to a reusable JD library. Use for: create job description, write JD, generate JD, update JD, clone JD, post to ATS, JD for [req/role], improve job posting, bias check JD, translate JD, save JD to library. Do NOT use for: interview feedback (use interview_debrief), offer justification (use offer_builder), or recruiting metrics (use good_morning_recruiting).
